prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN: GEN airdrop registration has reopened 'for a few more days' at airdrop.genlayer.com (the only official link). No new closing date or time given. Any token claiming GEN before an official contract is a scam.
CEO @0xshai joins @ronitA380 for a live talk on AI agents in finance, Wed 10/28 at 3 PM GMT (10 AM CT), on YouTube and X. No TGE confirmation yet; the Nov 11 date is still from the MiCA filing only.

Unaffiliated fan account @FlopNetwork is posting a 'FLOP tokenomics' thread (4.4B genesis airdrop, ~459M float). Flop Labs and Arthur Hayes have published no tokenomics; ignore it. No FLOP token exists and any token using the name is a scam.

GEN tokenomics paper is live: 4.2B genesis supply; community 25%, Foundation 20%, early contributors 19.06%, Labs 17.64%, investors 13.29%, DeepThought DAO 5%; about 24.4% effective float at TGE; insiders 12-month cliff; inflation 8.93% falling to 4%. TGE date still not announced.

CoinGecko shows a GenLayer preview page with an Ethereum contract 0x4242424228c275c5b44e24c53f081e9246025a2f. GenLayer has not posted this address and said the token moves to Arbitrum, so treat it as Unverified. Airdrop registration closed Mon 10/26.
QMS testnet passed 22.5M transactions and 3.3M addresses in four weeks (16M a week ago). Testnet only; no token, airdrop or points announced.
Founder Shashank Yadav: the biggest platform update (proactive trading agents) is "coming soon". No TGE confirmation; the Nov 11 date is still only in the MiCA filing.
A community account says DAC set an AMA with CIO Davide Costa for Fri 11/20, two days before the reported Nov 22 TGE. Not posted by @dac_chain; stays REJECT 48.

Third party (AirdropAlert): incentivized testnet Tue 11/3, mainnet and TGE Q1 2027, 4.4B genesis airdrop, early applications open on their site. None of this is on @flop_labs. Arthur Hayes says there is no FLOP token, so the Solana token AirdropAlert links is fake.

Ritual mainnet and RITUAL token are live; first listing on Coinbase (RITUAL-USD). Bridged RITUAL on Base and BSC is 0x256E...8C37. 18% of 10B supply unlocked at launch; insiders locked 1 year; supply uncapped.

report.intro: Quiet night for alerts: no new HIGH PRIORITY (0 of 3). GenLayer published its official GEN tokenomics (TGE still undated), Ritual added Gate and MEXC on its second day, and Quantus QTC can now be swapped natively on InstaSwap via NEAR Intents.

report.disclaimer: Research, not financial advice. Snapshots only; verify every contract yourself.
takeaways: No new alerts. Ritual (76) was alerted Mon 10/26; it is now on Coinbase, Gate and MEXC but still has no real DEX pool (official Base pool about $6).
GenLayer: official tokenomics paper is live (4.2B supply, about 24.4% float at TGE, insiders on a 12-month cliff). Score 70 to 71; still needs a dated TGE, an audit and an official contract.
GenLayer airdrop registration closed Mon 10/26, so it is off the open-campaign list. A CoinGecko preview shows an Ethereum GEN contract that GenLayer has not posted: Unverified.
Quantus: native QTC swaps live on InstaSwap through NEAR Intents (official); $74.52, +3.8%.
NaoX is the renamed Naoris (NAORIS); KuCoin spot opened 5 AM CT with a trade-to-earn GemSlot until Tue 11/3. Score unchanged at 55 (closed-source client, 15% float).
Open campaign still running: Quip Points (no end date). Axis, NaoX and TermiX promos this morning need trading or paid actions, so they are not free campaigns.
Rejected: fake Ritual claim guides, VEYA, Vantax and Nonce Protocol.

Quip (65) needs a dated TGE; DAC (48) needs @dac_chain to post its own date and contract.
Ritual's Coinbase 24h range ($0.0175 to $0.09) still includes listing-hour spikes; use the current $0.022 area, not the high. No CoinGecko page yet, so market cap is left blank.
NaoX (NAORIS) is the renamed Naoris Protocol: KuCoin listing today; DEX route Uniswap on ETH/BSC per CoinGecko.
Before an official contract, any token named GenLayer, Fraction, Dataline, Pond or Flop is a scam.
Soqucoin is the only niche SafeTrade token with a fresh milestone this week (NonKYC); Quantus SafeTrade volume is about $141k of its $1.9M total.

Tier comes from the Oracle Score (75+ Strong, 55 to 74 Watch, under 55 Speculative). It does not reflect market cap, and "No DEX" only means there is no official DEX route, not that a project is low quality.

Pearl (PRL) has no official DEX route. The Uniswap WPRL token comes from a third-party bridge and the Solana "PEARL" pools showing tens of millions are fakes. Its $644M market cap is circulating; fully diluted value is about $3.8B.
Tier comes from the Oracle Score, not market cap. QRL and Abelian have no DEX because QRL and ABEL tokens on Base or Solana are impostors; Abelian also trades on only one exchange (MEXC).
